integrity: Proof is all-dimensional and symbolic. Finite enumerations are independent corroboration. No claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: Proved only when one rectangular-band factor has cardinality two; labels fixed. Two-sided here means one permutation works for both multiplication orders, not the literature definition of strong complete mapping. A previously unnoticed enumeration of constrained permutation arrays could imply the formula; independent priority and external audit have not been established.
title: Exponential scarcity of simultaneous left-and-right transversals on two-row rectangular bands
